task_title: Velocity engineer agent and A/B trial lab

plan_review.notes: Separate-model plan review (rubber-duck, gpt-5.5) on the A/B lab design. 4 blocking + 2 non-blocking: benchmark overfitting, insufficient leak prevention, primary-metric mismatch, survivorship-biased corpus, censoring bias, junctioned node_modules. Divergence: minor but real - the lab was demoted from arbiter to pre-screen and a field-signal requirement was added; leak handling was redesigned from prevention to detection after the proposed prevention was empirically disproven.

rounds.notes: Both High severity, both the silent-zero class. (1) isUsable did not exclude trials with error set, so a crashed launch whose verifier passed anyway entered the medians as a zero-turn zero-token fastest run. (2) ContextMetrics could not distinguish no-context-used from event-log-missing, so an unmeasured arm won every context comparison. Fixed: isUsable now requires !error; added ContextMetrics.available gating summarizeArm/buildComparisons plus explicit warnings. 4 regression tests added.

Verified both round-1 fixes complete; confirmed stats correctness (Cliff delta tie handling, bootstrap percentile indexing, assertOneFactor). Found one remaining instance of the same root cause: summarizeArm computed passed/passRate off raw verifierPassed, so a crashed or leaked trial still inflated the arm pass rate. Fixed to count usable over attempted; 2 regression tests added, one stale test updated. Reviewer confirmed nothing else outstanding.
